import numpy as np, os, re, math, json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
g1=np.array(G['Demo pair 1 output']); g2=np.array(G['Demo pair 2 output'])
tab={}
for nm,g in [('d1',g1),('d2',g2)]:
    H,W=g.shape
    lr=[r for r in range(H) if (g[r]==3).all()][0]
    lc=[c for c in range(W) if (g[:,c]==3).all()][0]
    quads={'TL':(range(0,lr),range(0,lc)), 'TR':(range(0,lr),range(lc+1,W)),
          'BL':(range(lr+1,H),range(0,lc)), 'BR':(range(lr+1,H),range(lc+1,W))}
    def af(i,qn): return lr-1-i if qn in ('TL','TR') else i-lr-1
    def bf(j,qn): return lc-1-j if qn in ('TL','BL') else j-lc-1
    for qn,(rs,cs) in quads.items():
        for i in rs:

                tab.setdefault((af(i,qn),bf(j,qn)),set()).add(int(g[i,j]))
